providers.page_desc: Configure connection details for your AI providers. Each LLM variant can use a different provider.
providers.api_style_hint: The request format this endpoint speaks; fixed for built-in providers. Chat Completions serves dialogue, actions and every other model. Decisions and System One serve the Decision Model (the Decisions LLM), which returns typed answers with probabilities instead of text; a Decision Model slot can only use a provider marked one of these, and other slots only Chat Completions providers.

providers.use_sse_hint: Enable Server-Sent Events for streaming responses. Disable for local models or providers that don't support SSE.
providers.cache_ttl_hint: How long the provider keeps a cached prompt prefix. 1 hour survives longer pauses between lines but costs more to write on providers that bill it (Anthropic). Providers without prompt caching, and Gemini, ignore this.

telemetry.consent.title: Help make SkyrimNet better?
telemetry.consent.body: Anonymous performance stats — which AI models are in use and how quickly they respond — help us keep SkyrimNet fast and smooth for everyone. It's the only thing SkyrimNet ever sends: never what you type, say, or hear; never your characters, your story, your mods, or anything that could point back to you.
telemetry.consent.stats: See the live community stats your data builds →
telemetry.consent.fyi: P.S. — SkyrimNet checks for a newer version at launch; that request also includes your app version and basic system info. No personal data, and it's a single toggle in Settings → Privacy.
